Name: Minecraft Horse Sounds
Author: vibergamota25
Description:
Adds sounds when mounting and dismounting your horse, as well as hoof sounds while galloping.
A Few Important Notes: Credits and Other Information
This mod uses sounds extracted directly from Minecraft, a game developed by Mojang Studios. Therefore, I have no intention of making any profit from it.
I created this mod to make riding horses more immersive, with a particular focus on players who, like me, are blind and therefore find the lack of sound feedback for our horses confusing and discouraging.
I also hope to add neighing sounds in the future, once I find something that I feel is good enough.
This is the first mod I've created with the community in mind, and I'm still quite inexperienced when it comes to modding and sharing my work. So please feel free to leave feedback, suggestions, or constructive criticism in the comments. Just remember to be respectful and polite when expressing opinions about things you don't like.
